address: Halpern Conservancy Board Building, 15a High Street, Rochester, Kent,ME1 1PY
bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea in the heart of historic Rochester at Café Nucleus, set in one of the town's grandest settings.  Afternoon Tea is served in the boardroom, reminiscent of a lost era with beautiful oak panelling, high ceilings, and a British made chandelier ‘The urchin’. Sterliza’s plants add a real touch of the far east into the room.  Enjoy a selection of finger sandwiches, including Kentish Honey Roast Ham with Tracklements English Mustard and John Ross Jr Aberdeen Scottish Smoked Salmon and Local Cream Cheese.  Fruited and plain scones are served with Rodda’s Cornish Clotted Cream and Wooden Spoon Kentish preserves and lemon curd, followed by a selection of Afternoon Fancies, Petit Fours, Truffles and Macarons from Bénodet, Brittany.  Add a glass of chilled Kentish Sparkling wine or Laurent-Perrier Champagne for that special celebration.  Gluten free and vegetarian dietary requirements can be catered for with advance notice.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 3.30pm to 5pm.
